title: Connections
subtitle: Apps whose tools can be steps in your flows. Each tool shows up in the editor.

add.title: Connect an app
add.description: The app must list its tools at <address>/api/tools, like Pincel does.
add.name: Name
add.urlHint: Pincel runs at http://localhost:4300 (start it with pnpm dev).

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.subtitle: Where your flows deliver results. Passwords and keys are encrypted and stay on this computer.

email.title: Email
email.description: Used by “Send an email”. Messages go out from your own mailbox.
email.passwordHint: Gmail, Outlook and iCloud need an app password (create one in your account’s security settings), not your usual password.

telegram.title: Telegram
telegram.description: Used by “Send on Telegram”. Create a bot by talking to @BotFather, then paste its token here.
telegram.tokenHint: @BotFather sends it after /newbot. It looks like 123456:ABC-DEF…
telegram.noChat: Where should messages go? Send any message to your bot on Telegram, then press Find my chat.
telegram.chatSet: Messages go to chat {{chatId}} unless a step names another one.
telegram.noChatsYet: Nobody wrote to the bot yet. Send it a message on Telegram and try again.

ai.title: AI (Claude)
ai.description: Used by “Ask AI”. What the step asks (with values from earlier steps) is sent to Anthropic.
ai.keyHint: Create one at console.anthropic.com → API keys. Usage is billed to your Anthropic account.
